name: Glorious
danger: Enemies grant {value}% more experience.
notes: Krogon's list 2026-11-27: "Monsters Grant +50-100% Experience". Reward allowed since decision 2 (8b overwritten). Name Claude's proposal.

name: Teeming
danger: {value}% more enemies can fight at once and reinforcements arrive faster.
notes: Krogon's list: "+50% Base Monster Density" (fixed, no range). Multiplies the tier's waves like the old Swarming (x1.5). Name Claude's proposal.

name: Brutal
danger: Enemies deal {value}% more damage.
notes: Krogon's list: "Monsters Deal +20%-100% Damage". Name Claude's proposal.

name: Frenzied
danger: Enemies attack {value}% faster.
notes: Krogon's list: "Monsters have +25-100% Increased Attack Speed". Name Claude's proposal.

name: Ruthless
danger: Enemy hits have a {value}% chance to deal double damage.
notes: Krogon's list: "Monsters have +10-50% Chance to deal Double Damage". Name Claude's proposal.

name: Sturdy
danger: Enemies have {value}% more health.
notes: Krogon's list: "Monsters have + 25-50% Extra Health". Never on a map with Mighty (decision 5, group health). Name Claude's proposal.

name: Mighty
danger: Enemies have {value}% more health.
notes: Krogon's list: "Monsters have +50-100% Extra Health". Never on a map with Sturdy (decision 5, group health). Name Claude's proposal.

name: Fleet
danger: Enemies move {value}% faster.
notes: Krogon's list: "Monsters have +25% Increased Speed" (fixed). Name Claude's proposal.

name: Unyielding
danger: Enemies can't be staggered.
notes: Krogon's list: "Monsters cannot be Staggered". Name Claude's proposal.

name: Ironskin
danger: Enemies take {value}% less physical damage.
notes: Krogon's list: "Monsters are immune to Physical Damage"; decision 5: "immune means takes 95% reduced damage". Physical = blunt, slash, pierce. Never with Warded (group immunity). Name Claude's proposal.

name: Warded
danger: Enemies take {value}% less elemental damage.
notes: Krogon's list: "Monsters are immune to Elemental Damage"; decision 5: 95% reduced. Elemental = fire, frost, lightning, poison (the four Corruption's resistances cover; spirit not included, Claude's reading). Never with Ironskin. Name Claude's proposal.

name: Withering
danger: You lose {value} health per second near the heart.
notes: Krogon's list: "Players have -5 Drain Life per Second" (fixed). Near the heart = within 96 m (decision 8). Name Claude's proposal.

name: Exhausting
danger: You lose {value} stamina per second near the heart.
notes: Krogon's list: "Players have -5 Drain Stamina per Second" (fixed); the game's base stamina regen is also 5 a second (Player.m_staminaRegen = 5f, 1.0.31 code). Within 96 m (decision 8). Name Claude's proposal.

name: Exposed
danger: You have {value}% less fire, frost, lightning and poison resistance near the heart.
notes: Krogon's list: "Players have -25%-50% to All Resistances". Fire, frost, lightning, poison (Corruption's resistances); subtracted from the gear total, below 0 = more damage. Within 96 m (decision 8). Name Claude's proposal.

name: Venomous
danger: Enemy hits add {value}% of their physical damage as poison.
notes: Krogon's list: "Monsters have +25-75% of Physical Damage as extra Poison Damage over 5 seconds". The game sets poison's length from the hit's size (SE_Poison), so the copy names no length. Name Claude's proposal.

name: Searing
danger: Enemy hits add {value}% of their physical damage as fire that burns over 5 s.
notes: Krogon's list: "Monsters have +25-75% of Physical Damage as extra Fire Damage over 5 seconds". The game's burning lasts 5 s (SE_Burning m_ttl 5). Replaces Smouldering (decision 1). Name Claude's proposal.

name: Stormcalled
danger: Enemy hits add {value}% of their physical damage as lightning.
notes: Krogon's list: "Monsters have +25-75% of Physical Damage as extra Lightning Damage". Name Claude's proposal.

name: Bountiful
danger: Enemies are {value}% more likely to drop gear, orbs and maps.
notes: Krogon's list: "Monsters have +100% Chance to Drop Additional Items". Overhaul decision 7: x2 on the drop chances, never a guarantee. This round's decision 3: Corruption's own drops only (magic, rare and unique gear, orbs, maps; not the game's creature drops); decision 4: multiplies with the tier, the stars and other loot affixes; decision 8: kills and the heart's spill. Name and copy: decision 9.

name: Glittering
danger: Enemies are {value}% more likely to drop orbs.
notes: Krogon's list: "Monsters have +100% Chance to Drop Orbs". x2 on every orb's chance (overhaul decision 7); multiplies (decision 4); kills and the heart's spill (decision 8). Name and copy: decision 9.

name: Runic
danger: Enemies are {value}% more likely to drop runes.
notes: Krogon's list: "Monsters have +100% Chance to Drop Runes". Runes don't exist yet: a later row until a round adds them (this round's decision 2). Name and copy: decision 9.

name: Bulwarked
danger: Gear drops are {value}% more likely to be shields.
notes: Krogon's list: "+10% Chance to Drop Shields", +100% per overhaul decision 7. Decision 5: tilts the pick (shields weigh x2 when gear drops; the number of gear drops is unchanged). Shields = the shield class of loot_bases.csv. Name and copy: decision 9.

name: Mailed
danger: Gear drops are {value}% more likely to be helmets and armour.
notes: Krogon's list: "+10% Chance to Drop Helmets and Armors", +100% (overhaul decision 7). Decision 5: tilts the pick. Decision 6: helmet, chest, legs and cape classes (backpacks are capes); not jewellery. Name and copy: decision 9.

name: Honed
danger: Gear drops are {value}% more likely to be melee weapons.
notes: Krogon's list: "+10% Chance to Drop Melee Weapons", +100% (overhaul decision 7). Decision 5: tilts the pick. Decision 7: every weapon that isn't ranged, pickaxes included. Name and copy: decision 9.

name: Fletched
danger: Gear drops are {value}% more likely to be ranged weapons.
notes: Krogon's list: "+10% Chance to Drop Ranged Weapons", +100% (overhaul decision 7). Decision 5: tilts the pick. Decision 7: bows, crossbows and magic staffs (skills Bows, Crossbows, ElementalMagic, BloodMagic). Name and copy: decision 9.
